svg.title: Basins, ponds & wetlands · Dry basin
svg.desc: Dry detention drains between events. A wet pond has permanent water below normal level, with storm storage above. Bank slope is shown separately in a metric triangle. Source claims: ponds. Conceptual cutaways use diagram coordinates, not metre construction dimensions. Profiles, layer proportions, process arrow positions and vegetation arrangements are assistant illustration choices. No layer depths, capacities, tank sizes, rates or wet loads are derived from this geometry. Dashed infiltration is conditional on soil and groundwater; arrow lengths do not indicate rates. The separate source slope triangle alone is metric.
